en.name: Victor II
en.summary: The last German pope of the Salian imperial era, who was present at Henry III's deathbed and helped secure the succession of the young Henry IV.
en.body: Victor II, another Henry III appointee, continued the reform agenda of his predecessors, presiding over further councils against simony. He was with Henry III at his death in 1056 and worked afterward to stabilize the empire during the minority of the child king Henry IV, a rare instance of the pope playing a direct role in imperial succession politics.
